steps.description: AI is off until a Church Manager or a System Manager turns it on, and your church can leave it off. This summary and the warnings below say what an AI app can see, change and send.
steps.label: Before You Turn AI On
steps.title: Before You Turn AI On

steps.description: To turn AI on, tick it, then tick the acknowledgment that shows below it, and save. On a site with many churches, only a System Manager or a Church Manager of every church can turn it on. Turning AI off closes MCP, but connected apps keep their tokens until you revoke them.
steps.label: Use AI in Churchit
steps.title: Use AI in Churchit

steps.description: Read each warning before you decide: what an AI app can see and change, where a hosted AI sends data, how text that guests write can steer the AI, who can connect an app and what happens when you turn AI off.
steps.label: Warning: An AI App Can See and Change What Its User Can
steps.title: Read Each Warning

steps.description: No switch stops staff who paste church data into an AI tool, or AI in other apps and browser extensions. Your church's own policy decides that. On a site with Flow, the sections after the warnings choose the records that go only to local or zero retention models, suggestions on new requests and a check of the models.
steps.label: Warning: No Switch Stops Every Use of AI
steps.title: What No Switch Stops
